from manim import *
import numpy as np

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section2Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        self.setup_layout("The Bridge: The Concept of Limits", [
            "Limits allow us to approach points precisely.",
            "Zooming in reveals the curve's local slope.",
            "Straight lines approximate curves at microscopic scales."
        ])
        
        # Setup plot elements
        axes = Axes(x_range=[-1, 3, 1], y_range=[-1, 3, 1], axis_config={"include_tip": False})
        curve = axes.plot(lambda x: x**2, color=WHITE)
        point = Dot(axes.c2p(1, 1), color=YELLOW)
        
        # Assets
        microscope = SVGMobject("/scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/microscope.svg")
        magnifying = SVGMobject("/scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/magnifying.svg")
        self.place_at_grid(microscope, 'B2', scale_factor=0.3)
        self.place_at_grid(magnifying, 'B4', scale_factor=0.3)
        self.add(microscope, magnifying)

        # Plot group
        plot_group = VGroup(axes, curve, point)
        self.place_in_area(plot_group, 'C3', 'F6', scale_factor=0.6)
        self.add(plot_group)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        # Limits allow us to approach points precisely.
        self.play(self.lecture[0].animate.set_color("#00CED1"))

        ))
        self.add(line)
        self.play(h.animate.set_value(0.1), run_time=2)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        # Zooming in reveals the curve's local slope.
        self.play(self.lecture[1].animate.set_color("#00CED1"))
        self.play(plot_group.animate.scale(1.5), run_time=2)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        # Straight lines approximate curves at microscopic scales.
        self.play(self.lecture[2].animate.set_color("#00CED1"))
        
        val_label = Text("Limit: slope -> 2", color=WHITE, font_size=20)
        self.place_at_grid(val_label, 'E4', scale_factor=0.7)
        self.play(Write(val_label))
        
        self.play(h.animate.set_value(0.01), run_time=2)
        self.wait(1)
